name: Workshop first, then the shops
why: Start with the two hour manga workshop while everyone is fresh, then the shopping is the reward. The day ends at the station side, close to the trains for your dinner reservation. The school recommends the 13:00 class for families.
steps: Two hours of drawing manga with a working manga artist, English interpretation included. Nicholas draws his own character and takes the pages home.
About 8 minutes on foot along Sunshine 60 Street.
Mugiwara Store and Pokémon Center Mega Tokyo
Sunshine City, Alpa 2F. The official One Piece store and Japan's largest Pokémon Center are on the same floor. Open to 20:00 on Sunday.
Gashapon Department Store and the One Piece Card Game shop
World Import Mart 3F, same building. Over 3,000 capsule toy machines, then Bandai Namco Cross Store with the official One Piece Card Game shop and Tamashii Nations figures. Open to 21:00.
Two floors of second hand manga, figures, anime goods and Pokémon cards. One Piece volumes in Japanese are everywhere. Open to 22:00.
Nine floors, one of the biggest anime shops in Japan. New manga, figures and limited goods across every series. Open to 21:00.
B2F of PARCO, right at the East Exit. The official Weekly Shonen Jump store: One Piece next to Naruto and Dragon Ball, with items sold nowhere else. Open to 21:00.
Ikebukuro Station East Exit. Dinner at 20:30 is yours.
moves: Everything is on foot. Workshop → Sunshine City about 8 min. Sunshine City → Animate about 5 min. Animate → PARCO about 5 min.
good: A family that wants the hands-on part done first and a relaxed shopping run after.
mind: The 13:00 class is open on December 20 and is the one the school recommends for families. Shopping bags get heavy by the end, so the last two stops are short. Most stores have a tax free counter, so keep your passports with you.
bars: Gashapon Department Store and Cross Store
